name: Rotfly Swarm

Traits.name: Carrion Bloom
Traits.text: When a creature dies within the swarm's space or at the end of its turn within 5 feet of it, the swarm feeds on the remains; it can't be Bloodied until it has fed again.
Traits.clause: The swarm's flies boil from one body to the next, and any corpse in its reach is stripped as it moves past. When a creat
Traits.expresses: stripping a corpse in a minute
Traits.expressedQuote: the swarm feeds on the remains

Traits.name: Swarm
Traits.text: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

Actions.name: Maggot Bite
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 6 (1d12) Poison damage, or 3 (1d6) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage if the swarm is Bloodied.

lore: Hatched in the wet rot of battlefield slaughter-pits, the swarm exists only to feed, following the smell of dying breath and leaving nothing behind but clean-picked bone.
